The '''University of the Universe''' was a learning institution that educated [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Attendance required tuition payments considered high by some, including [[F-23-DKMx]].<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
This university was mentioned in the dialogue of droid F-23 in the queue for the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction.<ref name="YouTube ST queue">{{YouTube|video=Bxy4eeyymug|text=TDL : Star Tours Queue Line No. 14|channel=@couperin9|name=couperin9}}</ref>
